segments.text:
V. 5.
Theſe twelve Jeſus ſent forth—Herein exerciſing his ſupreme Authority, as GOD over all. None but GOD can give Men Authority to preach his Word. Go not—Their Commiſſion was thus confined now, becauſe the Calling of the Gentiles was deferred till after the more plentiful Effuſion of the Holy Ghoſt on the Day of Penticoſt. Enter not—Not to preach; but they might to buy what they wanted, John iv. 9.
